# Text to speech

Generated by BootAgent. It calls `minimax-speech-2.8-turbo` on the user's PPIO account. BootAgent rewrites this Skill when the model or Provider changes, so do not edit it.

## When to use

When the user asks you to turn text into spoken audio: reading out a summary, producing a voice-over draft.

## Command

Run the script in this Skill's directory (the directory containing this `SKILL.md`):

```bash
node <this Skill's directory>/scripts/run.mjs speak --text "<text>" [--voice <voice ID>] [--format mp3|wav|flac|pcm] [--speed <0.5-2>] [--out <file or directory>]
```

- `--text`: what to say, at most 9999 characters. Split longer text into several runs.
- `--voice`: a MiniMax system voice ID. Default `English_Graceful_Lady`; others include `English_Insightful_Speaker`, `English_Persuasive_Man`, `Chinese (Mandarin)_Lyrical_Voice` and `Japanese_Whisper_Belle`. Quote IDs that contain spaces.
- `--format`: audio format. Default `mp3`.
- `--speed`: speaking speed from 0.5 to 2. Default 1.
- `--out`: a file path, or a directory. Default `bootagent-output` in the current directory.
- `--timeout`: seconds to wait. Default 120.

The saved file path is printed to stdout. Existing files are never overwritten.

## Rules

- Every run costs money, billed by the length of the text. Before each run, tell the user what text you are about to speak and wait for them to agree.
- Never print, echo or log environment variables, `~/.bootagent/skill-env/ppio.env`, or anything that could reveal the API key. The script reads the key itself; you never need it.
- Only send files the user asked about. They go to the user's own Provider and nowhere else.

## Exit codes

| Code | Meaning | What to tell the user |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Success | Report the result. |
| 2 | Bad arguments or input file | Fix the command, or ask the user for the right file. |
| 3 | Setup problem: Node.js older than 18, or no API key found | Ask the user to restart the Agent so it picks up `BOOTAGENT_PPIO_API_KEY`, or to reinstall this Skill from BootAgent. |
| 4 | The Provider refused the request | Show the Provider's message. The model may not support this input; the user can choose another model in BootAgent. |
| 5 | The Provider rejected the API key | Ask the user to check the PPIO key in BootAgent. |
| 6 | The Provider was unreachable, busy or timed out | Suggest trying again later. |

`node <this Skill's directory>/scripts/run.mjs check` confirms the key is available without sending a request.
